posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Ah, right. That's because closing the message window doesn't end your cutscene event. Try this?
JavaScript:
$gameMap._interpreter.command115();  // Exit Event Processing on main interpreter
SceneManager._scene._messageWindow.terminateMessage();
Note that this will skip any other stuff left in the cutscene: move routes, switch/variable changes, etc.

posts.author: firestalker
posts.body:
Thanks to ShadowDragon and the others that helped...  This is solved.
The Solution, for those that want it, is simple:
You need two events [One of them Common]
You need at least one Variable
The first event has to be on the map [and each map that Cutscene uses] and it has to be Parallel Process by itself [This cannot be included in the event controlling the Cutscene].
It should be set up like this:
◆If：Script：Input.isTriggered("escape")
◆Script：$gameMap._interpreter.clear();
：      ：$gameMessage.clear();
◆Script：$gameMap.eraseEvent($gameVariables.value(1));
◆Common Event：Cutscene Skip
◆
：End
Click to expand...
The Variable should be the first line of the Controlling Event, and it should be set to the EventID [Controlling Event = 1; Variable 1 = 1]. You will have to add this Variable to all the controlling events in the Cutscene on each map. Make sure you set up the variable with the right number.
Now set up a Common Event. This event should have all the Self switches, Variables, and Switches that the Cutscene uses in it. Now I had it setup so that I can repeat the Cutscene over and over again, but if you want to setup for a one-time thing then you need to make sure that everything that happens in the Cutscene is controlled by something that can be flipped [Self Switch, Switch, Variable, Etc.]. The Common Event will be where you flip all these switches and such so that the cutscene thinks it's finished. You will also want to give the player any items or skills or whatever that they might get during the Cutscene as well. You might have to figure out a way to avoid giving the player double the items though if the player closes the cutscene after receiving the item...
I think I've held your hand some... DM me if you have any questions.
